fields.label: HDR10
fields.help: Requires HEVC Main10 on the PC and HDR enabled on its display. The stream reports whether HDR is actually active.

fields.label: Use a virtual display
fields.help: Apollo creates a display at the selected resolution and frame rate. Requires its virtual-display driver and device permission on the PC. A PC-side display-mode override takes precedence. Sunshine ignores this option.

fields.label: Wake-on-LAN
fields.help: A PC must be paired once while online to learn its network card address. Wake-on-LAN must be enabled in its firmware and network settings.
